name: Save feedback
description: Saves the interviewee's three feedback answers on the most recently completed interview. Works after the interview is finalized.

inputFields.label: Helpfulness rating
inputFields.description: Answer to: how helpful was the agent in documenting your knowledge? A rating from 1 to 5, captured as text.

inputFields.label: Improvement feedback
inputFields.description: Answer to: what would you like to improve, which functionality did you miss? Free text.

inputFields.label: Intuitiveness rating
inputFields.description: Answer to: how intuitive was the agent to use? A rating from 1 to 5, captured as text.
